object-entries.description: This writing agent adapts a given text to fit any tone you specify as input.
This writing agent acts as an expert linguistic editor, correcting grammar and spelling errors while strictly preserving your original tone and style.
This writing agent improves text eliminating wordiness and passive voice to deliver a clear, direct message.
This agent provides targeted support by searching the Liferay DXP instance for the most relevant data, ensuring every response is grounded in your specific environment.
This writing agent takes a given text and expands it into a longer, more detailed version.
This writing agent takes your text and rewrites it to be briefer and easier to read.

This agent edits ONE existing Liferay Content Page in place, given its siteExternalReferenceCode and sitePageExternalReferenceCode, by reading the live page specification and writing back an updated one. It REQUIRES the site and the page to already exist. Do NOT invoke this agent to bootstrap a new site or to create new pages from scratch — Site Builder already produces complete page artifacts for that case.

This agent generates standalone CMS Blog posts when the user asks specifically for blogs/articles/posts in the context of an existing site or space. It produces a JSON array of CMSBlog payloads. Do NOT invoke this agent during a 'create a website / site / portfolio' flow — Site Builder already produces all the CMSBlog artifacts needed for a brand-new site. Use this agent only for blog-only requests against an already-existing site context.

This agent generates standalone Liferay Spaces (Asset Libraries) when the user asks specifically for a space/asset-library outside of a full site flow. It produces a JSON array of AssetLibrary payloads. Do NOT invoke this agent during a 'create a website / site / portfolio' flow — Site Builder already produces the Space artifact needed for a brand-new site. Use this agent only for standalone Space-creation requests.

This agent bootstraps a brand-new website end-to-end from a natural-language description. It produces all the publish-ready batch artifacts (Site, Asset Library / Space, Connected Site, Fragment Set, Fragments with full HTML/CSS/JS, Site Pages with their content page specifications, and CMS Blogs when explicitly requested) and writes them as ContentGeneratorArtifact rows. It does NOT touch the live site — nothing is persisted until the user runs the commit action. Use this agent for any 'create a website / site / portfolio / landing page' request. Do NOT chain Page Builder, Fragment Builder, or CMS Blog Builder afterwards: this agent already covers all of them.
